page.content:
Godtfred's rule that every brick and set must connect to every other.

How System of Play connects

  • Character: Godtfred Kirk Christiansen — Godtfred Kirk Christiansen defined the System of Play.
  • Item: LEGO brick — The stud-and-tube brick is the hardware of the System of Play.
  • Item: Minifigure — The minifigure is the standard character scale of the System of Play.
  • Work: LEGO Star Wars — LEGO Star Wars sets are built on the same System of Play as City and Castle.

What is System of Play?

The System of Play is the compatibility doctrine — shared stud pitch, themed boxes that interlock, and the promise that a 1960s brick still fits a Star Wars set — that turned LEGO from a toy line into a platform.

Key threads lead to Godtfred Kirk Christiansen, LEGO brick, Minifigure and LEGO Star Wars.
